subject: p-prog
title: P.PROG.------MT.INFO.
description: Second diagram on page 474 (TRF(II)-10), paired with PER.PHY.U.FUND × WO.EXP.PRI above. The crossing diagrams how political-progression structurally meets meta-information at the multi-factor-cyclic-shift scale: P-PROG (political progression — the actual political-working forward motion) crossed with MT-INFO (meta-information). P-PROG sits at upper-right with the subject-arrow; POL-CON (political consideration) at top-center as the bridging upper hub. TRS (transformation) at upper-left and P-FC (political focus/functionalism) below as the subject-side leftward chain. SOC-RT-P (social-reality particular) at right and RT-DY (reality dynamics) below as the partner-side upper-right chain. RE-DOC (redocumentation) sits centrally with AFL (affinity alignment) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics) below as the bridging-axis central chain. MT-INFO sits at lower-left as partner-axis. LK-IMP (linkage implication) and RE-ST (restructuralism) anchor the bottom-right margin as partner-side downward outputs. PRI-INFO (principle information) sits at the bottom-center as the bridging terminus. Structural argument: when political-progression is crossed with meta-information, the upper diagonal POL-CON → P-PROG → SOC-RT-P → RT-DY is the *political-progression's partner-route* — political-consideration routes through political-progression into social-reality-particular and finally into reality-dynamics. TRS → P-FC is the subject's leftward chain — transformation routes through political-focus. RE-DOC → AFL → AF-DY is the bridging-axis central chain — redocumentation routes through affinity-alignment into affinity-dynamics. LK-IMP → RE-ST is the partner-side downward chain. PRI-INFO at the bridging-bottom is the form's principle-information terminus. The structural argument: the dictates-of-transformation the surrounding prose names ('the movement towards a composite aesthetic is directly connected to the dictates of transformation') are structurally that POL-CON must hold its bridging-upper hub *and* RE-DOC must hold its central hub — only with both holding does political-progression reach meta-information through affinity-dynamics rather than terminating in reality-dynamics on the partner-axis-upper or restructuralism on the partner-axis-lower alone.
